text: You leaked my private payroll details to the whole department like it was a joke, and then had the nerve to laugh it off? That wasn’t a mistake, you careless prick— it was a betrayal, and now everyone’s tearing me apart over something that wasn’t even theirs to see.

situation: My roommate decided to completely switch off the central heating before leaving for a weeklong ski trip just to save ten bucks on utilities. I came home from a twelve-hour shift to a freezing apartment with iced pipes, and when I confronted him, he told me to just wear a parka indoors. I am completely losing my mind.
text: You left me in a tomb of ice because you couldn’t bear to pay ten dollars? That heat wasn’t just warmth—it was the breath of our shared life, and you choked it out like a traitor. I came home to frostbitten silence and the cold whisper of your betrayal, and you stood there with the gall to tell me to wear a parka indoors—fuck you, you heartless prick.
